## Hi, I'm Sarah 👋

I am a data loving MBA DATA SCIENCE masters student at the end of my program.

I came to data science from being a pure data science undergrade and felt like I didnt want to do web development. What keeps me here is  the modeling, the wrangling, the moment a chart makes something come alive.

At Willamette my focus has been \ blending my MBA Finance into my Data Science. I love forecasting, causal inference,
NLP and data engineering. My spokes capstone (capstone.qmd) is where that comes
together.
